short_description: A dumbbell shoulder exercise that lifts the arms out to the sides to target the lateral deltoids.
how_to: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise both arms out to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the weights slowly back down.
correct: Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout.
Keep your wrists in line with your forearms.
mistakes: Don't shrug your shoulders as you lift.
Don't swing your torso for momentum.
Don't raise your arms above shoulder height.
Don't let the weights drop fast.

short_description: An overhead pressing movement that builds shoulder and triceps strength.
how_to: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold weights at shoulder height.
Keep your core tight and your back straight.
Press the weights directly overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the weights back to shoulder height with control.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't arch your lower back under load.
Don't rush the descent.

short_description: A rotational plank variation that challenges core stability and oblique strength.
how_to: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Rotate your hips to one side, lowering them toward the floor.
Return to the centre position.
Rotate to the other side.
Continue alternating at a controlled pace.
correct: Keep your body in one line.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't lift your hips too high.
Don't twist so far that you lose control.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A short-range chest pressing movement that keeps the muscles under constant tension.
how_to: Lie on your back with weights held above your chest.
Lower the weights to just above your chest.
Press up a few centimetres, then lower again in small pulses.
Keep the range of motion tight and controlled throughout.
correct: Keep your lower back pressed gently into the surface.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't bounce the weights off your chest.
Don't hold your breath during the pulses.

short_description: A close-grip push-up variation that places extra emphasis on the triceps and inner chest.
how_to: Place your hands close together beneath your chest, forming a diamond shape.
Extend your legs behind you in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward your hands while keeping your elbows close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Keep your elbows controlled close to your sides.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let your lower back arch.
Don't rush through the movement.

short_description: A rotator-cuff exercise that strengthens the small muscles that stabilise the shoulder joint.
how_to: Stand or sit with your upper arm tucked against your side.
Bend your elbow to ninety degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your body.
Return slowly to the starting position.
Repeat on each side.
correct: Keep your upper arm against your side.
Move with control through the full range.
mistakes: Don't let your elbow drift away from your side.
Don't rush the rotation.
Don't use your whole torso to swing the arm.
Don't force the range further than comfortable.

short_description: An overhead triceps stretch that loosens the back of the upper arm and shoulder.
how_to: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Use the opposite hand to gently press the elbow further back.
Hold where you feel a gentle stretch.
Release and switch arms.
mistakes: Don't force the stretch by pulling hard.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't let your lower back arch as you reach up.
Don't rush through the hold.

short_description: A chest-opening stretch that targets the front of the shoulder and the pectoral muscles.
how_to: Clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and gently draw your shoulder blades together.
Lift your clasped hands slightly if comfortable.
Hold where you feel a stretch across your chest and shoulders.
correct: Keep your chest open and tall.
mistakes: Don't force the stretch.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't round your upper back forward.
Don't jerk your arms to increase the stretch.

short_description: A cardio drill that throws alternating punches to elevate the heart rate and work the shoulders.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hands raised to guard position.
Extend one arm forward in a controlled punch.
Retract it and extend the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms at a steady rhythm.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
correct: Keep your core tight on each punch.
Move at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Don't lock out your elbow on each punch.
Don't hunch your shoulders up to your ears.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't swing wildly and lose your balance.

short_description: A standing stretch that lengthens the biceps and the front of the forearm.
how_to: Extend one arm straight out to your side with your palm facing up.
Gently press your fingers back with your opposite hand.
Hold where you feel a stretch along the front of your arm.
Switch to the other arm.
correct: Keep your shoulder relaxed and down.
mistakes: Don't force the stretch.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't shrug your shoulder during the hold.
Don't rush through the stretch.
